business: Good Car Club (GCC) - Stage 1: refurbished used alloy wheels, sold locally in north Kent
by_segment: Everyday driver replacing damaged or ugly wheels
Hobbyist or modifier who knows wheels
why_not: Three hundred quid of my money going to a brand new seller with no reviews, paid by bank transfer, for wheels I can't see yet? On Marketplace I'd just keep scrolling and compare with other sellers I can message and see feedback on.

New seller with no reviews and I have no idea how long they've been around, so I'd be handing over £300 on faith. I also don't want someone coming to my home or having to sort out collection, and I'd be stuck if the wheels turned out to be bent.
I'm not driving out to Bexleyheath or Gillingham to collect wheels from some stranger. And I can't tell from words alone whether they'll look good, I need to see photos of the actual set.
No tyres mentioned, so I'd be paying £300 and then still need four tyres on top. Brand new seller with no reviews and I'd be handing over cash for wheels I can't judge myself.
flip: Seeing real photos of the actual set, reviews or local people who've bought from them, a written fit guarantee, and a warranty on the finish for at least 6 months, ideally with a way to pay that protects me.
A few real reviews from local customers, or being able to see the wheels in person before paying, with a pay-on-collection option.
Seeing the exact set in person first, or real reviews, at around £220 to £240 with a pay-on-collection option.
Real photos of the exact set I'd get, a few reviews or people I know who've bought, and being able to see them in person and pay on collection.
Delivery to my door plus real photos of the exact set, ideally from a seller with some reviews.
